title: zz-knowledge-v1
description: The native OKF profile for a ZZ knowledge concept. A record satisfying this schema is a native Decision/Rule/Fact/Defect exported by this platform. A record that does NOT satisfy it may still be a perfectly valid, importable OKF document — see 'legacy-okf' and 'legacy-raw' in services/zz-core/src/tenant-info/export.ts. Passing this schema is a structural fact only: it certifies neither that the concept's claim is true, nor that any person approved it — that is the platform's separate gate/approval workflow.

type.description: The OKF concept type. Native concepts use exactly one of these four; any other value belongs to the 'legacy-okf' profile instead.

zz_profile.description: Computed by the platform when a record is validated as native — never trusted from imported input. A foreign type carries 'legacy-okf'; malformed bytes carry 'legacy-raw'.

resource.description: The described underlying asset this concept is ABOUT. Never platform identity — that is zz_artifact_id.

zz_artifact_id.description: Stable platform identity for this concept. Never the described resource — that is 'resource'.

generated.description: Content-change time, not a competing timestamp field.

oneOf.description: An unauthorized or unavailable source citation. Carries exactly this one key — never a ref, resource string or reason that would leak the citation's identity.

verified.description: The CURRENT applicable verification event(s) only. A bare mapping (rather than a list) is accepted on import and normalized to a one-element list here; history lives in log.md, not in this field.

verified_against.description: Subject-VERSION evidence from a foreign tool — preserved verbatim, never converted into a 'verified' event. Nobody performed that verification; this string does not assert that anybody did.

stale_after.description: Preserved exactly when supplied by the source document. Never required, never auto-filled by this platform.

content_fields.description: Native semantic extension fields (SemanticPayload.content_fields), carried through verbatim.
